description: Context pack schema for microtask delegation. Workers must not infer missing system context.

requiredFields.description: Concrete action for this worker turn or spawn.
Outcome that satisfies the parent task or acceptance criterion.
Paths the worker may read or change; omit only when truly local.
Functions, types, routes, config keys the worker must respect.
Upstream/downstream modules, services, or data this slice touches.
Invariants, conventions, API contracts, non-goals from captain or project.
Artifact: patch, report section, test list, decision record format.
Explicit exclusions to prevent scope creep.

conditionalFields.when: Context dependency MEDIUM or higher, or worker lacks repo-wide conventions.
conditionalFields.description: Architecture summary, state machines, auth boundaries, retry/failure rules.

sufficiencyGate.question: Could a worker complete this without discovering hidden global state?

dependencyCheckPrompts: What could go wrong without whole-system understanding?
Retry, failure, or external dependency behavior?
